images.filename: USS Ingersoll (DD-652) underway in the Pacific Ocean, circa in 1960.jpg
images.caption: The U.S. Navy destroyer USS Ingersoll (DD-652) underway in the Pacific Ocean, circa in 1960. Stoddard was assigned to Destroyer Division (DESDIV) 212 as part of the screen of the aircraft carrier USS Bennington (CVS-20) for a deployment to the Western Pacific from 1 October 1960 to 2 May 1961.

images.filename: USS Grosbeak (AMS-14), possibly at Norfolk, Virginia (USA), circa in the later 1940s (L45-112.04.01).jpg
images.caption: The U.S. Navy minesweeper USS Grosbeak (AMS-14), possibly at Norfolk, Virginia (USA). In the background are the destroyer USS Knapp (DD-653), USS Ingersoll (DD-652) and other ships, all being "mothballed". The photo was therefore taken between mid-1946 and late 1950 when both destroyers were in reserve.
